title: Onboard vela-13b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Priya Kapoor
release_notes: Added vela-13b v1.0 to the model registry with curated metadata, per-hardware performance profiles, and automated changelog generation for registry releases. Includes test coverage and docs. No breaking changes.
description:
Context: Onboarding request for vela-13b v1.0. This PR adds model metadata, performance profiles for the most common serving configurations (gpu-a100-40g, gpu-a10, cpu-64), and integrates the model entry into the registry changelog automation so releases automatically include the new model in generated release notes. Motivation: vela-13b shows strong latency/throughput characteristics for instruction-tuned workloads we care about; adding it to the catalog enables customers and internal benchmarks to rely on a verified profile.

What this PR does (high level):
- Adds models/vela-13b/v1.0/metadata.json with model family metadata, provenance, license, and recommended default config.
- Adds models/vela-13b/v1.0/perf_profiles.yaml containing perf profiles (p50/p95 latencies, throughput, memory footprints) across target hardware. Profiles were produced by benchmark-lab runs (see linked Linear).
- Hooks the new model into scripts/changelog/generate_changelog.py so the automated changelog includes an entry when registry manifests are released.
- Adds a docs page docs/models/vela-13b.md with quickstart example and caveats for quantized variants.
- Adds tests/test_perf_profiles.py with smoke checks validating profile schema and sanity thresholds.
- Updates .github/workflows/model-registry.yml to ensure perf-profile validation runs in CI.

Checklist: 
- [x] Metadata includes source and license info.
- [x] Perf profiles validated against schema and benchmark outputs.
- [x] Changelog automation picks up new model entry.
- [x] Documentation page added.
- [x] Unit tests added and CI passing.

Deployment notes: After merge, the release tooling will pick up the new model on next manifest release. No additional infra changes required. If customers want to pin older behavior, they can continue to reference older model version tags.

Related: Linear ENG-2481 for perf verification, PM-133 for product go/no-go. Benchmark artifacts uploaded to benchmark-lab run 2026-02-10.

CI: Initial pipeline failed on a flakey perf-profile linter due to timeout; re-run passed (see CI summary).

Reviewers: please pay attention to: perf profile numbers (are the p95 numbers realistic for a10/gpu targets), schema compliance for metadata, and changelog automation behavior for edge cases when changelog generator runs in dry-run modes.
